fields.q: 丹提的作品太棒了！来，我念一段给你听！
fields.en: Dante's work is amazing! Here, let me read you something!
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 丹提的作品太棒了！来，我念一段给你听！

en.value: Dante's work is amazing! Here, let me read you something!

fields.q: 父亲总说我是出色的剑士。不过用斧头就从来没让他满意过……
fields.en: Father always said I was a fantastic swordsman. Couldn't ever impress him with axes, though…
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 父亲总说我是出色的剑士。不过用斧头就从来没让他满意过……

en.value: Father always said I was a fantastic swordsman. Couldn't ever impress him with axes, though…

fields.q: 我在商会拼命干活。呼！我觉得我需要休个假。
fields.en: I've been working so hard at the company. Whew! I think I need a vacation.
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 我在商会拼命干活。呼！我觉得我需要休个假。

en.value: I've been working so hard at the company. Whew! I think I need a vacation.

fields.q: 其实我自己也写点东西。应该写一篇以你为主角的故事。
fields.en: You know, I do a little bit of writing myself. I should write something with you as the main character.
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 其实我自己也写点东西。应该写一篇以你为主角的故事。

en.value: You know, I do a little bit of writing myself. I should write something with you as the main character.

fields.q: 前几天看到一对情侣，好热烈啊！有点让人羡慕。
fields.en: I saw this couple the other day, and they had so much passion! Kinda made me jealous.
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 前几天看到一对情侣，好热烈啊！有点让人羡慕。

en.value: I saw this couple the other day, and they had so much passion! Kinda made me jealous.

fields.q: 要是我有翅膀？我要周游世界，看遍这一生能看的一切。
fields.en: If I had wings? I'd travel the world and see everything this life has to offer.
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 要是我有翅膀？我要周游世界，看遍这一生能看的一切。

en.value: If I had wings? I'd travel the world and see everything this life has to offer.

fields.q: 呃！黏糊糊、油腻腻的……我最讨厌脏东西了。
fields.en: Ugh! Gummy, sticky, greasy… I just hate dirty things.
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 呃！黏糊糊、油腻腻的……我最讨厌脏东西了。

en.value: Ugh! Gummy, sticky, greasy… I just hate dirty things.

fields.q: 总有一天，我想当一场伟大冒险的主角。你要跟我一起去吗？
fields.en: One day, I'd love to be the main character of some grand adventure. Would you want to come with me?
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 总有一天，我想当一场伟大冒险的主角。你要跟我一起去吗？

en.value: One day, I'd love to be the main character of some grand adventure. Would you want to come with me?

fields.q: 呜呜。原来我喜欢的人已经有对象了……我该怎么振作起来……
fields.en: Ugggh. Turns out, the person I like already has a partner… How will I ever recover…
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 呜呜。原来我喜欢的人已经有对象了……我该怎么振作起来……

en.value: Ugggh. Turns out, the person I like already has a partner… How will I ever recover…

fields.q: 作为一只鸟你真聪明。你不会是故事里那种化身成鸟的精灵吧？！
fields.en: You're pretty smart for a bird. Are you one of those spirits in disguise like in the stories?!
fields.name: 露露蒂雅

q.value: 作为一只鸟你真聪明。你不会是故事里那种化身成鸟的精灵吧？！

en.value: You're pretty smart for a bird. Are you one of those spirits in disguise like in the stories?!
